items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: And then with Jimmy Noon clarinet added a little while later.

ctx.x: And I don't think he worked with Johnny out there because around that time I think maybe Jimmy Noon was working at a place on 35th Street that they called, a nightclub called The Nest I think at that time. See.
That was close to all the other clubs there wasn't it? Between Entertainers and Sunset Summer and that. Was The Nest on the corner do you have to remember?
